sender.en: An Instagram, Facebook or “declutter” vendor page

name.en: Online vendor collects payment for a sofa, laptop or phone that never arrives

how.en: A vendor page on Instagram, Facebook or a declutter group advertises phones, laptops, furniture or foodstuff at low prices. They reassure you, insist you pay in full before delivery, then stop responding and block you on Instagram and WhatsApp. The page often changes its name and keeps the same adverts up to catch the next buyer.

text.en: A page offers an item at a good price, often as “declutter” or “sales”.
The vendor insists on full payment before delivery or pickup.
They rush you, saying many people want the item.
After payment they stop replying and block you.

Hello dear, the sofa set is still available, ₦280k last price because we are relocating. Pay full to the account and our rider will deliver tomorrow morning. Many people are asking, pay now to secure it.

en: instagram vendor blocked me after payment
paid for item that was never delivered
declutter page collected money and disappeared
vendor insisted on full payment before delivery
online seller stopped replying after i paid
vendor changed page name after collecting payment
pay before delivery scam on instagram
Full payment before delivery, with no pay-on-delivery option.
A page that is new or has changed its name many times, with comments turned off.
Prefer pay on delivery, or meet in a safe public place and check the item before paying.
Search the page name and account number online for complaints before you pay.
If you paid, call your bank at once to try to stop the transfer and report to the NPF-NCCC and the FCCPC.

sources.title: Fake sellers, real losses: How marketplace sellers scam Nigerians through declutter groups
